This rented plot must give me a good harvest to cover the rent and help feed my family, so I will plant improved maize seed from the market and buy a few bags of chemical fertilizer, though I cannot afford the full amount the extension workers recommend. I will also buy herbicide and maybe some insecticide because the armyworm has been destroying maize around here. We have no irrigation in our area, so I am waiting for the rains to start. My children and I will do most of the work on this 0.26 hectare plot, but I may hire two or three laborers for a couple of days when the weeds are bad and at harvest time.
